name: Zoom Events
description: Zoom Events is a virtual and hybrid event platform for conferences, sessions, hubs, tickets, registration, exhibitors, engagement, reporting, and video on demand.
agentUseSummary: Connect a customer-owned Server-to-Server OAuth app with one granular list scope, then inspect a bounded content-free page of event lifecycle metadata.

capabilities.label: Read event lifecycle
capabilities.description: Inspect bounded content-free Zoom Events type, status, and schedule metadata.

approvalRequired.label: List event lifecycle
approvalRequired.description: List one bounded page of content-free Zoom Events lifecycle metadata.

blocked.label: Identity and content
blocked.description: Event names, descriptions, taglines, IDs, hub IDs, URLs, contacts, physical locations, countries, categories, tags, calendars, recurrence detail, and raw records are not returned.

blocked.label: People and access
blocked.description: Registrants, attendees, co-editors, speakers, exhibitors, sponsors, tickets, access links, authentication policy, invitations, email, and attendee actions are not exposed.

blocked.label: Sessions, reports, and media
blocked.description: Session content, reservations, surveys, attendance, engagement, chat transcripts, custom reports, VOD, recordings, files, livestreams, and analytics are not exposed.

blocked.label: Changes and raw API
blocked.description: Event/session/ticket/access/exhibitor/VOD changes, uploads, actions, and arbitrary paths, filters, cursors, origins, headers, bodies, or tokens are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every account-associated Zoom Events lifecycle read requires matching Relay approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected lifecycle reads run without Relay per-action approval while fixed origins, endpoint, bound, redaction, audit, scope, licensing, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one approval-aware content-free Zoom Events lifecycle tool and obtains short-lived account tokens server-side.
Railway mounts one approval-aware content-free Zoom Events lifecycle tool and obtains short-lived account tokens server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: A customer administrator must activate a Server-to-Server OAuth app with only zoom_events:read:list_events:admin, provide encrypted credentials, and have a Webinars Plus or Events license.
providerSetup.nextAction: Configure the dedicated customer app and Railway credentials, verify licensing and scope, exercise Safe denial/approval and Dangerous reads, verify renewal/revocation, deploy through the integration lane, and run live acceptance.

evidence.supports: Zoom documents GET /v2/zoom_events/events, the Webinars Plus or Events license prerequisite, event lifecycle fields, and private identity/content/access fields that Relay excludes.
Zoom maps List events to zoom_events:read:list_events:admin and separates sessions, attendees, access links, tickets, reports, VOD, exhibitors, files, and mutation scopes.
Zoom enhanced the list-events endpoint in June 2026; Relay consumes only a fixed allowlist of stable lifecycle fields.
